_comment: Spec for scripts/deb-copyright.py: the DEP-5 copyright file that the .deb
and the AppImage install as /usr/share/doc/copywraith/copyright (the Flatpak,
repacked from the .deb, as /app/share/doc/copywraith/copyright). Paths are
relative to this file; npm run notices:deb sets RUST_DOC and RUSTC_VERSION

components.name: Rust crates, npm packages and fonts
components.license_text: The Rust crates linked into the binary and the npm packages and fonts of its embedded web frontend keep their own licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, Unicode-3.0, Zlib, BSL-1.0, CDLA-Permissive-2.0, MPL-2.0, OFL-1.1 and others). Their full license texts, copyright notices and source links, including the Source Code Form of the MPL-2.0 crates, are in Third-Party-Notices.txt, next to this file.
copyright: The authors of each component, as listed in Third-Party-Notices.txt

components.comment: The full notices, including those of the standard library's own dependencies, are in Rust-Licenses.html next to this file.
